newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BANKS EXTEND GAINS ON MIXED BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: BANKS EXTEND GAINS ON MIXED BOURSE.

text.p: * Official list shares jump 21.65 points to 1000.24 points.
* Wider group-A list sags 18.38 points to 1834.78 points.
* Hermis Bank soars to 241 litas from 229 litas as Vilniaus Bank advances to 253 litas from 249 litas.
* Brokers say Hermis will stop at 250 litas in the coming week, increasingly optimistic about Vilniaus Bank by year end.
Hermis Bank shares climbed to within four litas of their all-time high and within 12 litas of rival Vilniaus Bank in mixed but heavy trading at Lithuania's stock exchange on Thursday.

The blue chips of the official list jumped 21.65 points to 1000.24 points while the wider group-A list sagged 18.38 points to 1834.78 points by the close. Central market turnover bounded up to 1.1 million litas from 527,000 litas.

Hermis Bank soared to 241 litas from 229 litas, near its all-time high of 245 litas, in central market turnover of 200,000 litas. Brokers say it may pass its old mark but take a short break afterwards.
"I think 250 litas will be the limit for the next week," one broker said.
Hermis shares also saw 69,000 litas worth of block trades at 229 litas.
Rival Vilniaus bank traded at 253 litas from 249 litas, closing in on its all-time high of 260 litas, in central market turnover of 214,000 litas.

Brokers who have long said Hermis had more upward potential are now switching back to Vilniaus Bank after it reported audited profits for the first six months that were almost double what they were in the same period last year.
"I think they'll do better in the third and fourth quarters," said one broker. "I think Vilniaus Bank could be more interesting."
Rokishkis Cheese, which reported impressive first half profits, advanced only slightly, to 44.50 litas from 44 litas in central market turnover of 49,000 litas.

Rokishkis saw heavy action in block trading, turning over 404,000 litas at prices ranging from 43.85 litas to 44 litas. Brokers say the large block deals at bargain prices are slowing Rokishkis's progress on the central market.
Group-A anchor Lithuanian Gas declined to 1.49 litas from 1.52 litas.
Shares in Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) sunk to six litas from 6.18 in 229,000 litas central market turnover. Brokers blame the drop on one large deal and say its price will recover.
"I think it was one client who wanted to close his position in LISCO," said one dealer.
